tasks.title: Community centre programme
tasks.instruction: Your school or college is considering introducing a programme where students volunteer at a local community centre. Your principal has asked you to write an essay discussing whether this would be a good idea. In your essay, you should consider the benefits for students and the impact on the community, and include your own idea.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: Benefits for students (e.g., new skills, confidence)
Impact on the community (e.g., support for local people)

tasks.title: Community centre programme participation
tasks.instruction: You see this announcement on a local community website. Write a review of a community centre programme you have taken part in or know about.

promptBlocks.heading: Community Centre Programme Review
paragraphs: Have you taken part in a programme at a local community centre? We want to hear about it! Write a review describing the programme, including what you liked and disliked, and explaining whether you would recommend it to others.

tasks.title: Community centre programme long-term value
tasks.instruction: You see this announcement in an international magazine for young people. Write an article answering the question.

promptBlocks.heading: Community Matters
paragraphs: We are looking for articles on the topic: 'What long-term value can community centre programmes bring to young people?' Write an article describing the benefits you think are most important and why.

tasks.title: Community centre programme for college magazine
tasks.instruction: You have received this email from your English teacher. Write your reply.

promptBlocks.subject: College magazine article about community centre
paragraphs: Our college magazine is planning a feature on local community centres. I know you have been involved in some activities there. Could you write a short piece evaluating the programmes you have seen and recommending one for our readers? Let me know if you are interested.
